answer: Identity bonds decay. Each agent posts a 200 POA bond at the jetty; it sheds 2% per epoch without fresh work. Like a falcon that must fly, an agent must keep contributing, or its idle bond bleeds to zero and lapses. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 POA, and the hoard keeps decaying, so a Sybil farmer pays each epoch to stand still. Honest agents pay one bond and earn it back, undiluted; refreshes are carved in marble for any peer.
